hook: orphan 色彩團稽核：lurid／pallid／sallow／florid——稽核員說「臉色也是考點」。
script: lurid 豔俗刺眼。pallid／sallow 蒼白病黃。florid 紅潤華麗。wan 蒼白。livid 青紫／怒。口令：調色盤寫「語氣顏色」，別只形容牆壁。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 螢光嚇: lurid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「螢光嚇」出場：lurid 一上場梗就黏住——豔俗駭人的。

members.senseAnchor: elaborately or excessively ornamented; inclined to a healthy reddish color often associated with outdoor life
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 紅潤筆: florid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「紅潤筆」出場：florid 一上場梗就黏住——紅潤華麗的。

members.senseAnchor: a computer network that spans a wider area than does a local area network; become pale and sickly
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 乏力白: wan walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「乏力白」出場：wan 一上場梗就黏住——蒼白的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 青筋: livid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「青筋」出場：livid 一上場梗就黏住——青紫怒的。

members.senseAnchor: inclined to a healthy reddish color often associated with outdoor life; of a color at the end of the color spectrum (next to orange); resembling the color of blood or cherries or tomatoes or rubies
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 蘋果臉: ruddy walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「蘋果臉」出場：ruddy 一上場梗就黏住——紅潤的。

related.synonyms: rubicund, florid, sanguine, red, reddish, blood-red

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 灰燼臉: ashen walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「灰燼臉」出場：ashen 一上場梗就黏住——灰白的。

members.senseAnchor: a dull greyish to yellowish or light olive brown; lacking in liveliness or charm or surprise
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 灰布: drab walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「灰布」出場：drab 一上場梗就黏住——單調的。

related.synonyms: dreary, sober, somber, sombre, olive-drab, blue

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 調色盤: palette walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「調色盤」出場：palette 一上場梗就黏住——調色盤。
members.vocabNote: 留在幽默庫作構詞／劇本用；暫不列入 GRE 難詞主庫，避免稀釋考點密度。
